source: Sri Lankan Academic Repository Target Inventory (Data-Collection Project Deliverable)
notes: OAI endpoints for groups B, C, D (DSpace) and SLIIT were inferred from verified DSpace/OJS software identification, not directly harvested at compile time. Confirm each with a live ?verb=Identify request before production use.
For DSpace 6 sites use /oai/request; for DSpace 7/8 (Angular UI) sites use /server/oai/request.
dspace.ac.lk (LEARN/ODRaaS) is a near-empty pilot as of mid-2026 and is deliberately excluded from harvesting; revisit quarterly.

2026-07-19 live validation pass (scripts/validate_repositories.py + manual web-search cross-checks): several sites only serve OAI-PMH over plain http:// (broken/absent HTTPS), one needs a 'www.' host prefix, and jfn_research/jfn_medicine's OAI service lives at the server root rather than under /ujrr or /med. endpoint_verified_live=true entries below were confirmed with a real ?verb=Identify response on that date; see each entry's notes for specifics.

2026-07-19 Week 3 large-scale harvest finding, IMPORTANT for planning: 'endpoint reachable' does not mean 'has harvestable data'. Of the 17 targets with a live OAI-PMH endpoint, only 7 (uom, cmb, seu, sltc, ruh, uwu, sliit) actually returned records via ListRecords/ListIdentifiers; the other 10 responded fine to ?verb=Identify and ?verb=ListMetadataFormats (and in several cases ?verb=ListSets shows real collections with content) but return 'noRecordsMatch' for the actual data query -- almost certainly a stale/unbuilt OAI index on the DSpace side (a known DSpace admin issue: 'dspace oai import' needs to be re-run after certain changes), not a wrong URL or missing content. scripts/validate_repositories.py now checks this directly (has_records field) instead of only checking Identify.

2026-07-20 update on the empty-OAI-index problem: PARTIALLY RESOLVED. For the DSpace 7/8 instances among the empty ones (pdn, nsf, busl), the public REST discover endpoint (/server/api/discover/search/objects?dsoType=item -- note /server/api/core/items returns 401) serves full qualified-DC metadata regardless of OAI index state; scripts/harvest_dspace_rest.py collected 100% from all three (7,682 + 15,792 + 2,873 items). The remaining empty-index institutions (jfn_research, jfn_medicine, ou, vpa, rjt, esn, vau) are legacy DSpace 5/6 with no public REST route (checked 2026-07-20: /rest paths 404, redirect to broken https, or redirect to intranet 192.168.x.x addresses) -- for these, outreach to their IT/library staff to rebuild the OAI index ('dspace oai import') remains the only fix. The 8 blocked/unreachable targets (kln, sjp, sab, wyb, kdu, ucsc, sljol, pgim) were re-validated 2026-07-20: all still blocked, no change.

Per-institution harvest_route field (where present): 'rest' = use scripts/harvest_dspace_rest.py; default/absent = OAI via scripts/harvest_oai.py or, for cmb/ruh (pagination-bug hosts), scripts/harvest_large_repository.py.

repositories.name: University of Moratuwa
repositories.notes: Pre-confirmed in prior research.

repositories.name: University of Colombo (main)
repositories.notes: Endpoint confirmed live 2026-07-19. OAI ListRecords pagination crashes around resumptionToken offset ~3000 (HTTP 500, 'No converter for [class java.util.LinkedHashMap]' -- Spring/DSpace serialization fault, not transient); date-slicing (harvest_large_repository.py) recovered 8,355 of ~8,540 but one window stayed broken. RESOLVED 2026-07-20 via the public REST discover endpoint -- full harvest collected all 8,447 items (scripts/harvest_dspace_rest.py --id cmb). Old xmlui instance on :8080 referenced in older records is gone (404) -- those are stale links, not missing content.

repositories.name: UCSC (Colombo School of Computing)
repositories.notes: Site itself is live and browsable at /jspui/ (confirmed via web search and direct fetch), but no OAI path returned a valid response: tried /oai/request, /jspui/oai/request, /dspace-oai/request over both http and https, all HTTP 404. Sitemap fallback also checked 2026-07-19 (sitemap_index.xml / sitemap.xml at both the domain root and /jspui/) -- none found either. This legacy JSPUI instance currently has no automated bulk-metadata access route; would need direct handle/browse-page crawling, or contacting the institution.

repositories.name: University of Peradeniya
repositories.notes: Confirmed live 2026-07-19, but OAI index is empty (noRecordsMatch on all queries/prefixes). RESOLVED 2026-07-20 via the public REST discover endpoint -- full harvest collected all 7,682 items (scripts/harvest_dspace_rest.py --id pdn). LEGACY GAP: the old instance dlib.pdn.ac.lk (still Google-indexed with real handle pages, OpenDOAR repository 4542) is completely unreachable as of 2026-07-20 -- connect timeout on http/https/www/:8080 -- likely offline or mid-migration into ir.lib.pdn.ac.lk. Peradeniya's historic collection may substantially exceed the new instance's 7,682 items; re-check dlib periodically and harvest it if it comes back.

repositories.name: University of Kelaniya
repositories.notes: Site is live and indexed publicly (confirmed via web search; http://repository.kln.ac.lk/ serves real content to browsers). But every scripted request we made -- https (SSL handshake fails: TLSV1_UNRECOGNIZED_NAME) and http on /oai/request, /xmlui/oai/request, /jspui/oai/request (all HTTP 403 with a 'NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW' WAF page) -- was blocked. Sitemap fallback also checked 2026-07-19 -- no sitemap reachable either (same block). Re-checked 2026-07-20: still blocked, URL confirmed canonical (OpenDOAR 3821), repository actively maintained (2025-2026 content visible to browsers/Google). Aggregator routes checked 2026-07-20: NOT in CORE (only 2 LK providers there: SEU and OUSL); FAO AGRIS lists University of Kelaniya as a data provider but that is an agriculture-only subset. Kelaniya-affiliated JOURNAL articles will still arrive via the OpenAlex LK-institution harvest (other pipeline); what stays inaccessible is repository-only content (theses, proceedings). Only route: outreach to Kelaniya library/IT for allow-listing. Also hosts Gampaha Wickramarachchi University of Ayurveda as a sub-community (see gwuas entry).

repositories.name: University of Sri Jayewardenepura
repositories.notes: https fails with SSLEOFError (no valid TLS listener); http connection is accepted then reset mid-request ('Remote end closed connection without response') on every retry. Site is documented as live via web search (dr.lib.sjp.ac.lk). Needs retest from a different network/IP before concluding it's actually down.

repositories.name: University of Jaffna (research repository, UJRR)
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19: OAI service lives at the server root (http://repo.lib.jfn.ac.lk/oai/request), NOT under /ujrr. https unreachable; must use http. OAI record store is truly empty -- ListRecords/ListIdentifiers/GetRecord all fail (sampleIdentifier namespace is 'oai:researchrepo:...'; even correctly-namespaced GetRecord returns idDoesNotExist), though ListSets shows 100+ real communities. No REST (/rest redirects to intranet 192.168.x.x), no sitemap. RESOLVED 2026-07-20 via HTML meta-tag crawl (scripts/harvest_html_meta.py): robots.txt is 404 (no restrictions declared), item pages embed full DC/DCTERMS meta tags; browse-by-title enumeration collected 11,049 items. Also has a community on dspace.ac.lk, but production repository stays on its own domain.

repositories.name: University of Jaffna (Faculty of Medicine)
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19: OAI service lives at the server root, NOT under /med. https unreachable; must use http. Same empty-OAI-store situation as jfn_research (see that entry). RESOLVED 2026-07-20 via HTML meta-tag crawl: 3,758 items collected (robots.txt 404, no restrictions declared).

repositories.name: South Eastern University
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19 over http (https unreachable; no valid TLS listener). A separate 'Digital Archive' also exists at ar.lib.seu.ac.lk -- not yet checked, may be a distinct DSpace instance worth a second look. Also has the cmb/ruh-style pagination-depth server bug, crashing plain harvest at ~5,902 of ~6,713 total records (88%). IMPORTANT: unlike cmb/ruh, the date-slicing workaround (harvest_large_repository.py) makes this WORSE for SEU (only found 273 records total) -- the OAI 'from'/'until' date filter appears to still walk the same underlying broken offset internally rather than reducing it, so date-narrowed queries hit the crash even on tiny/empty ranges. For this institution specifically, use the plain harvest_oai.py (accept the ~5,902-record partial result), not the date-sliced script.

repositories.name: Open University of Sri Lanka
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19 over http (https SSL handshake fails). Also known as digital.lib.ou.ac.lk. OpenDOAR-listed. OAI index empty (noRecordsMatch); legacy DSpace, no REST/sitemap route. POSSIBLE RECOVERY ROUTE found 2026-07-20: OUSL is one of only two Sri Lankan data providers aggregated by CORE (core.ac.uk, provider id 13528, 'The Open University of Sri Lanka: OUSL Digital Archive') -- CORE holds a harvested copy from when the OAI feed worked. Querying it properly needs a free CORE API key (registration required); worth doing alongside outreach to OUSL to rebuild their index.

repositories.name: University of Visual & Performing Arts
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19 over http (https unreachable). Confirmed via OpenDOAR.

repositories.name: Rajarata University
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19 over http (https unreachable).

repositories.name: Buddhasravaka Bhiksu University
repositories.notes: Hosted under NSF infrastructure, distinct from dl.nsf.gov.lk itself. Verified 2026-07-19: original guess (/oai/request, DSpace 6-style) was wrong -- it's actually DSpace 7+ and needs /server/oai/request. Its own <baseURL> self-reports as https://repo.busl.ac.lk/server/oai/request. OAI index empty (noRecordsMatch). RESOLVED 2026-07-20 via the public REST discover endpoint -- full harvest collected all 2,873 items (scripts/harvest_dspace_rest.py --id busl).

repositories.name: University of Ruhuna (IRUOR)
repositories.notes: Confirmed XMLUI DSpace; exact version not read. Endpoint inferred from software, confirmed live 2026-07-19. Same pagination-depth server bug as cmb (see that entry) -- plain harvest crashed at ~1,992 records. scripts/harvest_large_repository.py's date-slicing workaround collected 14,743 of ~15,290 total records (96%); one narrow window (2024-11-03..2024-11-15) could not be recovered.

repositories.name: Eastern University (EUSL e-Repository)
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19. Two fixes vs. the original inference: (1) needs the 'www.' host prefix -- the bare digital.lib.esn.ac.lk does not resolve (DNS NXDOMAIN); (2) must use http, not https (no valid TLS listener). Legacy /rest may possibly be available, unconfirmed.

repositories.name: Sabaragamuwa University
repositories.notes: Note the non-standard :8080 port. Confirmed XMLUI DSpace; exact version not read. 2026-07-19: port 8080 is completely unreachable from this environment (connect timeout on the bare host, before even reaching a path) -- could be an outbound firewall on this network blocking non-standard ports rather than the server being down. Retest from a different network before concluding it's dead.

repositories.name: Wayamba University (WUSL Repo)
repositories.notes: 2026-07-19: unreachable on both https and http (connect timeout on both). Unlike most others in this batch, an http fallback does not fix it -- looks genuinely down or blocked, not just a bad cert. Web search confirms the URL itself is correct (repository.wyb.ac.lk), so retest later or from another network.

repositories.name: Uva Wellassa University (UWU eRepo)
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19: OAI endpoint live but effectively unusable -- ListRecords 500s on the second page (resumptionToken=oai_dc////100) and on every date-filtered query, even empty 1990 ranges, so neither plain pagination nor date-slicing works; 100 records was the OAI ceiling. RESOLVED 2026-07-20 via the public REST discover endpoint -- full harvest collected all 8,897 items (scripts/harvest_dspace_rest.py --id uwu).

repositories.name: University of Vavuniya (DRR)
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19 over http (https unreachable). Legacy /rest may possibly be available, unconfirmed.

repositories.name: Gen. Sir John Kotelawala Defence University (KDU)
repositories.notes: Registered in Jisc SHERPA/Sherpa Services (repository ID 10783, ROR 04n37he08) as a DSpace repository, corroborating status, and the site's homepage does load. But every OAI/REST path attempt failed: https://ir.kdu.ac.lk/server/oai/request -> HTTP 404; http:// on the same path -> HTTP 522 (Cloudflare 'origin connection timed out'). This looks like the actual DSpace backend behind Cloudflare is down or misconfigured, not a wrong URL -- worth a direct check with KDU's library/IT.

repositories.name: Gampaha Wickramarachchi University of Ayurveda
repositories.notes: No own repository; output deposited as a community inside University of Kelaniya's repository.kln.ac.lk (see kln entry), already covered by that OAI feed.

repositories.name: Buddhist and Pali University of Sri Lanka
repositories.notes: No public DSpace/OAI repository found; publishes journal(s) via SLJOL.

repositories.name: Ocean University of Sri Lanka
repositories.notes: Library page exists; no research repository/OAI found.

repositories.name: University of Vocational Technology (UoVT)
repositories.notes: No public repository/OAI found.

repositories.name: National Science Foundation (NSF), Colombo
repositories.notes: Verified 2026-07-19: OAI endpoint live but its index is empty (noRecordsMatch on every ListRecords/ListIdentifiers query, all metadata prefixes). RESOLVED 2026-07-20 via the REST route: /server/api/core/items returns 401, but the public discover endpoint (/server/api/discover/search/objects?dsoType=item) serves everything -- full harvest collected all 15,792 items (scripts/harvest_dspace_rest.py --id nsf). High-value aggregator confirmed: 'Journals Published in Sri Lanka' and 'Conferences and Workshops of Sri Lanka' communities. Deduplicate against institutional feeds.

repositories.name: NSF -- SLJOL journal platform
repositories.notes: 176 journals, 25,506 articles, 2,988 issues (as of July 2026). Richest single journal-article feed for Sri Lanka; covers institutions lacking their own repository (PGIA, PGIS-adjacent, Pali & Buddhist Studies, Buddhist & Pali University). 2026-07-19: direct access WAF-blocked (403 on everything, incl. GET /). DELIBERATE DECISION: no WAF-bypass attempts -- official access would need an NSF request. RESOLVED 2026-07-20 via Crossref instead: all SLJOL articles carry DOIs under NSF's prefix 10.4038, and Crossref's public REST API serves the same bibliographic metadata openly -- scripts/collect_sljol.py collected all 26,200 works (more than the homepage's claimed 25,506). Note Crossref records lack abstracts for most SLJOL items and carry no subject keywords; if full abstracts are needed later, that's an argument for requesting official SLJOL/OJS access from NSF.

repositories.name: Postgraduate Institute of Medicine (PGIM), Colombo
repositories.notes: Site states 'updated daily'. RSS 1.0/2.0 + Atom feeds at /feed/... Item count not independently confirmed. 2026-07-19: https is unreachable (no TLS listener; connect timeout) -- must use http. Homepage and robots.txt both load fine over http (200), but /oai/request returns HTTP 403 from an Apache Tomcat error page (access denied), tried also at /jspui/oai/request and /dspace-oai/request (both 404). robots.txt reveals the DSpace sitemap config points at an internal IP (192.248.21.144), suggesting a semi-broken/internal-facing config. Looks like OAI harvesting may be restricted server-side rather than just a wrong path -- worth asking PGIM directly, or scraping via the RSS/Atom feeds and handle browsing as a fallback.

repositories.name: SLIIT (Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology)
repositories.notes: 4,309 items on home page (3,600 Articles, 290 Theses; top depositor 'Jayathilaka, R' with 163 items). Verified 2026-07-19: reachable and returns a valid Identify response, but its HTTPS certificate fails validation (SSL cert error). A production harvester will need to either fix trust for this host deliberately (log it, don't silently disable verification globally) or wait for SLIIT to fix their cert.

repositories.name: Other private/SLIATE institutes (NSBM, ICBT, Horizon, Saegis, ESOFT, NIBM, SLINTEC, Inst. of Chemistry Ceylon, CA Sri Lanka, SANASA Campus, NISD, IIHS, SLIATE ATIs, others)
repositories.notes: No genuine research repository with programmatic access found; teaching-focused. Re-check NSBM and IIHS annually as their research output grows.

repositories.name: LEARN shared platform (dspace.ac.lk / ODRaaS)
repositories.notes: Run by Lanka Education and Research Network as 'Open Digital Repository as a Service', backend dspace-b.ac.lk. As of mid-2026 holds only 2 communities (pilot/training) -- not yet a production national aggregator. Do not build a harvester yet; revisit quarterly. If it grows beyond ~5 populated institutional communities, re-evaluate consolidating harvests here.
